title: Grand refit v2 on r45 with an extra-tropical objective (declared before any evaluation)
made_after: Grand refit v1 finalist passed dev49 (0.99458) and fine28 (0.982) but failed sealed set j (1.016; tropics) and, on the spent pool, worsened the Siberias (+12-20 % rain loss). The model's map spans 28-48 deg; the wet equatorial interiors (Congo, Amazon, 3-7 % of observed rain) are out of scope here and recorded as an open problem. Sealed set k (map latitudes) declared before this plan.
search: Coordinate descent (scripts/joint_refit.py) as v1; at most 70 evaluations.
objective: S over the 49 development regions plus the 16 extra-tropical spent-pool regions (65, equal weight) against r45.
selection: Lowest objective point; must pass policy_v3 dev (S49<=0.995, T,P<=+1%) and fine28 against r45; then sealed set k once.
caveat: The objective includes the development gate's regions; only fine28 and sealed set k are independent.
